verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a locally runnable Snyk CLI, including `snyk secrets test` for hard-coded secrets and `snyk code test`, but nothing documents a pre-commit hook integration or a way to block commits. Wiring the CLI into a git hook would be a user-side workaround. The Snyk Studio 'hooks' are agent-environment hooks for AI coding assistants, not git pre-commit hooks, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the scanner as a pre-commit hook so secrets and issues never enter my git history
